thread:
maria: heads up — planning a tiny engine kernel swap on the kv-slate tonight (low traffic window). wanted a quick alignment on owners, quick validation steps, and rollback posture. target window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

aj: I can own the deploy slice for the window. will be on call. what's the exact change?

maria: it's a small kernel bump (runtime v2.14.1 -> v2.15.0) plus a tweak to the quant profile (kv-cache defaults -> profile-B). no model changes. main risk: unexpected latency bump for short sequences.

devon: can you paste the quant profile diff? want to sanity-check kv hit behavior.

maria: sure — small diff: 
```
- kv_cache.max_entries=1024
- quant.profile=profile-A
+ kv_cache.max_entries=2048
+ quant.profile=profile-B
```

aj: thanks. plan for validation: quick warmup + 10m traffic replay to canary slab, measure p50/p95 and token throughput. if p95 regresses >10% revert.

sam-ops: need drain plan for affected slots. I'll cordon 2 pods, ensure remaining capacity handles 50% extra. also confirm autoscaler scaling policy won't spam new nodes.

maria: agree. rollout steps: 1) apply kernel on canary slab (2 hosts), 2) run replay job (replay id: replay/2026-03-17/kv-slate), 3) observe perf for 12m, 4) promote if green, otherwise roll back.

aj: for rollback quick command: 
```
# rollback to previous kernel image
kubectl set image ds/runtime runtime=image:redwood/runtime:v2.14.1 -n runtime-prod
```

nisha: I'll wire up console alerts — p95 latency, error-rate, and kv-miss-rate. also add a temporary dashboard tile for quant-profile delta QPS.

devon: add me on the replay run (I want to check KV miss heatmap). also ensure we capture CPU/GPU utilization on the canary.

sam-ops: noted. I'll disable autoscaler bumping during the 15m observation window to avoid confounding signals.

maria: good. owners: @aj deploy lead, @sam-ops capacity, @nisha observability, @devon perf validation. I'll coordinate post-run notes in this thread.

aj: quick ask — if we see a small p95 blip (~5%) but stable p50 and no errors, do we proceed or revert?

devon: my take: tolerate up to 7% p95 for this change if kv-miss-rate drops and throughput improves; otherwise abort.

maria: sounds reasonable. decision policy recorded: p95 <=7% regression allowed if kv-miss-rate improves >=3% and no increase in 5xx.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window for runtime:v2.15.0 on 2799955555 02:00 UTC (owners: aj). Reaction: :white_check_mark:

aj: I'll post a start signal 5m before and a final go/no-go at +12m. everyone please ack if you're good with the policy.

nisha: ack. I'll be watching the dashboard.

devon: ack. will join the replay run.

sam-ops: ack. I'll handle cordon/drain and the autoscaler pause.

maria: thanks all — keeping the window small and rollback-first if anything smells off. will update here after the canary run. :thumbsup:
